scientific.integrity: The primary Wigner source and closest cusp-comparison source were materially inspected. The new family theorem is reduced to exact trigonometric identities and a cubic discriminant calculation, replayed independently by the packaged symbolic checker.
limitations: Only cusp counts are classified; global topology and self-intersections of the singular curves are not.
The exact convexity region in the coefficient space is not solved; positivity of the radius of curvature is assumed.
The individual support 31+2 cos(2t)+sin(5t) is prior illustrative material, not part of the originality claim.

title: Five-cusp saturation for a two-harmonic family of convex ovals
